Which medical schools brought in the most NIH money in fiscal year 2019?

SELECT org_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE ed_inst_type = 'SCHOOLS OF MEDICINE' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2019' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of recorded solar installations change from 2012 to 2022?

SELECT substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE substr(cast(installation_date AS varchar), 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2022') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
In which languages does ChEBI give the most international nonproprietary names?
SELECT language_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_names WHERE type = 'INN' AND language_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.candidate_committee_linkages
Which medical specialties received the most industry money in 2021?

In 2022, how did notices, proposed rules and final rules compare in number?
SELECT doc_type, count(*) AS documents FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE issue_date LIKE '"2022-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_research WHERE product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 <> '' AND product_category_or_therapeutic_area_1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many atoms does the largest QM9 molecule contain?
SELECT max(natoms) AS highest FROM govblock_chemistry.qm9_molecules

SELECT applicant_full_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE applicant_full_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many working residents did Puerto Rico have in 2007?
SELECT sum(c000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'pr' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2007

SELECT collaborations, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE collaborations LIKE '[%' AND collaborations <> '[]' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

What was the personal saving rate in April 2020?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS saving_rate FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadatam WHERE seriescode = 'A072RC' AND period = '2020M04'

SELECT naics_description, count(*) AS subawards FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE naics_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much in import duties did the United States collect on goods arriving in 2024?
SELECT sum(try_cast(cal_dut_mo AS double)) AS duties FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl WHERE year = '2024'

SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(npopchg2024 AS double) AS change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE maketxt = 'TOYOTA' AND substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2010'
Which research concepts are tagged on the most works?
SELECT display_name, try_cast(works_count AS double) AS works FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_concepts ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT assay_organism, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_assays WHERE assay_organism IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the peak hourly electricity demand on California's grid on March 18, 2022?

Which states have the most clinicians opted out of Medicare?
SELECT state_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cms_opt_out_affidavits WHERE state_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How have pedestrian deaths changed over the last ten years on record?

SELECT death_yr AS year, count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND try_cast(death_yr AS integer) BETWEEN 2000 AND 2100 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which large cities have the highest adult obesity rate?

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS city, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_place WHERE measureid = 'OBESITY' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND try_cast(totalpopulation AS double) >= 500000 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

How are hospitals filing fiscal 2023 cost reports owned: nonprofit, for-profit or government?

SELECT CASE WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('1', '2') THEN 'Nonprofit' WHEN cast(prvdr_ctrl_type_cd AS varchar) IN ('3', '4', '5', '6') THEN 'For-profit' ELSE 'Government' END AS ownership, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_rpt WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT substr(recalldate, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE substr(recalldate, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2023') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

What was the median home purchase loan in 2023?

SELECT approx_percentile(try_cast(loan_amount AS double), 0.5) AS median_loan FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(loan_purpose AS varchar) = '1'

SELECT states, count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'dbra' AND is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT max(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) AS peak_wind_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE fuel_category = 'Wind'

SELECT mesh_heading, count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE mesh_heading IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants

SELECT respondent_state, count(DISTINCT lei) AS lenders FROM govblock_finance.hmda_ts WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN study_type = 'OBSERVATIONAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_health.ct_studies

SELECT CASE political_party WHEN 'd' THEN 'Democratic' WHEN 'r' THEN 'Republican' WHEN 'i' THEN 'Independent' WHEN 'f' THEN 'Federalist' WHEN 'w' THEN 'Whig' ELSE political_party END AS party, count(DISTINCT person_id) AS judges FROM govblock_courts.people_db_political_affiliations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many economically significant rules did OIRA finish reviewing in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed WHERE economically_significant = 'Yes' AND cast(date_completed AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Which states have retired the most generators?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled

What share of approved federal information collections gather personal information?

Which papers are cited most often by other papers in PubMed?
SELECT ref_pmid, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_health.pubmed_references WHERE ref_pmid <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2reactome

SELECT parent_legal_business_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE parent_legal_business_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT value AS labor_force FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUST360000000000006' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M13'
Which states are home to the most registered section 527 political organizations?
SELECT column11 AS state, count(*) AS organizations FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8871 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many vehicle defect investigations did NHTSA open each recent year?
SELECT substr(cast(c7 AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT c1) AS investigations FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_investigations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT emergency_class, count(*) AS events FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_event_notifications GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT count(*) AS theses FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE document_type LIKE '%thesis%'

SELECT statename, count(*) AS closed FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_029 WHERE sy_status_text = 'Closed' AND school_year = '2022-2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sum(try_cast(fac_inspection_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_state = 'OH'

SELECT CASE trim(denial_reason_1) WHEN '1' THEN 'debt-to-income ratio' WHEN '2' THEN 'employment history' WHEN '3' THEN 'credit history' WHEN '4' THEN 'collateral' WHEN '5' THEN 'not enough cash' WHEN '6' THEN 'unverifiable information' WHEN '7' THEN 'incomplete application' WHEN '8' THEN 'mortgage insurance denied' ELSE 'other' END AS reason, count(*) AS denials FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar_2007_2017 WHERE cast(as_of_year AS varchar) = '2010' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '3' AND trim(denial_reason_1) <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Lockheed Martin or Boeing receive more federal contract dollars in fiscal 2023?

SELECT CASE WHEN upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE 'LOCKHEED MARTIN%' THEN 'Lockheed Martin' ELSE 'Boeing' END AS company, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND (upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE 'LOCKHEED MARTIN%' OR upper(recipient_parent_name) LIKE '%BOEING%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ee_country, count(*) AS assignments FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignee WHERE coalesce(ee_country, '') NOT IN ('', 'UNITED STATES') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do New York's Davis-Bacon wage determinations set for electricians, in pay and fringe benefits?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate, round(avg(try_cast(fringe AS double)), 2) AS avg_fringe FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_dba_rates WHERE wd_number LIKE 'NY%' AND classification LIKE 'ELECTRICIAN%' AND try_cast(rate AS double) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
Which states had the cheapest electricity across all sectors in 2024?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'ELEC.PRICE.%-ALL.A' AND length(series_id) = 19 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) <> 'US' AND period = '2024' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) AS year, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states are home to the most federal award recipients?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_lookup WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND lower(title) LIKE '%medicare%' ORDER BY date LIMIT 5

SELECT comm_desc, sum(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_comm WHERE year = '2024' AND month = '12' AND comm_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Scorecard Most Recent Field Of Study

Which agencies made the most awards in fiscal 2024?

SELECT awarding_toptier_agency_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND awarding_toptier_agency_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT substr(start_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS studies FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE phases LIKE '%PHASE3%' AND substr(start_date, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10

SELECT year, month3_emplvl AS employed FROM govblock_labor.qcew_quarterly WHERE area_fips = '36061' AND cast(own_code AS varchar) = '5' AND industry_code = '10' AND cast(year AS varchar) IN ('2019', '2024') AND cast(qtr AS varchar) = '1' ORDER BY year

SELECT provider_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_healthcitations WHERE state = 'NY' AND provider_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_033 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND data_group = 'Free and Reduced-price Lunch Table' AND lunch_program LIKE 'Free lunch qualified%'
Which procedures did doctors perform most often for Medicare patients in 2019?

SELECT hcpcs_desc AS service, sum(try_cast(tot_srvcs AS double)) AS services FROM govblock_health.medicare_physician_other_practitioners_by_geography_and_service WHERE rndrng_prvdr_geo_lvl = 'National' AND source_file LIKE '%D19_Geo%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT max(try_cast(value AS double)) AS megawatts_out FROM govblock_energy.eia_nuc_status_data WHERE series_id = 'NUC_STATUS.OUT.US.D' AND period LIKE '2024%'

SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.NG-US-99.A' AND period IN ('2005', '2024') ORDER BY 1

SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT value AS hires_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_jt_data WHERE series_id = 'JTS000000000000000HIL' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which titles of New York's laws have the most sections?
SELECT title_name, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'ny' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many oral argument recordings does the archive hold?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.oral_arguments
Which organisations hold stakes in the most nursing homes?

SELECT owner_name, count(DISTINCT federal_provider_number) AS nursing_homes FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_ownership WHERE owner_type = 'Organization' AND owner_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many children were hospitalized for asthma in the Bronx in 2016?

SELECT count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Bronx' AND age_group = '0 to 17' AND ccs_diagnosis_description = 'Asthma' AND cast(discharge_year AS varchar) = '2016'

SELECT f.facility_name, sum(try_cast(e.co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e_tons FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission AS e JOIN govblock_environment.ghg_dim_facility AS f ON f.facility_id = e.facility_id AND f.year = e.year WHERE e.year = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT avg(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_fec.contributions_to_candidates WHERE transaction_dt LIKE '%2024'

How many federal civil cases in the Integrated Database were filed in 2015?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database WHERE substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2015'

SELECT utility_name, try_cast(res_rate AS double) AS dollars_per_kwh FROM govblock_solar.urdb_zip_rates WHERE zip = '10001' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT count(DISTINCT recipient_uei) AS companies FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'RI' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024'

SELECT concat(locationname, ', ', stateabbr) AS county, try_cast(data_value AS double) AS percent FROM govblock_health.cdc_places_county WHERE measureid = 'ACCESS2' AND datavaluetypeid = 'AgeAdjPrv' AND year = '2022' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' AND state = 'XX' AND product_name LIKE 'HUMIRA%'

SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS million_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.SALES.US-ALL.A' AND period = '2023'

SELECT security_term, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_treasury.auctions_query WHERE security_term IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal assistance programs are listed in SAM.gov?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_assistance_listings

Which materials have the highest computed refractive index?

How did the number of reactions found in granted patents change from 1980 to 2015?
SELECT cast(year AS varchar) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE cast(year AS varchar) IN ('1980', '2015') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states had the highest unemployment rates in December 2024?

SELECT a.area_text AS state, try_cast(d.value AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data d JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_series s ON s.series_id = d.series_id JOIN govblock_labor.bls_la_area a ON a.area_code = s.area_code WHERE s.area_type_code = 'A' AND s.measure_code = '03' AND s.seasonal = 'S' AND cast(d.year AS varchar) = '2024' AND d.period = 'M12' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the Henry Hub natural gas spot price on February 17, 2021?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_mmbtu FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.RNGWHHD.D' AND period = '20210217'
Which kinds of measurement are most common among ChEMBL bioactivity results?
SELECT standard_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_activities WHERE standard_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York's highest hourly electricity demand in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(demand_mw AS double)) AS peak_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2022'
Which conditions have the most approved treatments?
SELECT mesh_heading, count(DISTINCT molregno) AS drugs FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_indication WHERE max_phase_for_ind = 4 AND mesh_heading IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many judicial confirmations were there each year from 2005 to 2014?

SELECT substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2005' AND '2014' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which subsidized housing programmes have the most projects?
SELECT program_label, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What exchange rate did the Treasury set for the euro at the end of 2024?
SELECT try_cast(exchange_rate AS double) AS euros_per_dollar FROM govblock_treasury.rates_of_exchange WHERE country_currency_desc = 'Euro Zone-Euro' AND record_date = '2024-12-31'
Which counties had more deaths than births in 2023 by the widest margin?
SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(naturalchg2023 AS double) AS natural_change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
Which patents granted in 2022 had the most claims?
SELECT patent_id, patent_title, num_claims FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE patent_date LIKE '2022%' ORDER BY try_cast(num_claims AS integer) DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies sponsor the most connected political action committees?
SELECT connected_org_nm, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees WHERE connected_org_nm <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much debt had the Black Lung Disability Trust Fund built up by the end of fiscal 2024?
Black Lung Disability Trust Fund Results

SELECT max(try_cast(fiscal_year_amt AS double)) AS cumulative_debt FROM govblock_treasury.black_lung_disability_trust_fund_results WHERE fiscal_year = '2024' AND account_desc = 'Cumulative debt, end of year'
Which cities' recipients take in the most sub-award money?

SELECT concat(sub_legal_entity_city_name, ', ', sub_legal_entity_state_code), sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search WHERE sub_legal_entity_city_name IS NOT NULL AND concat(sub_legal_entity_city_name, ', ', sub_legal_entity_state_code) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did Defense Department contract obligations change from fiscal 2015 to fiscal 2024?

SELECT cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) AS year, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE upper(awarding_agency_name) = 'DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE' AND cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) IN ('2015', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which universities own the most U.S. patents?

SELECT disambig_assignee_organization AS university, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated WHERE upper(disambig_assignee_organization) LIKE '%UNIVERSITY%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Materials Project entries are theoretical, with no known lab synthesis?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(theoretical AS varchar) = 'true'
Which New York ZIP codes reported the most total income on tax returns for 2021?
Income by ZIP Code and County

SELECT zipcode, sum(try_cast(a00100 AS double)) AS agi_thousands FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE state = 'NY' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%' AND zipcode NOT IN ('00000', '99999') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of the water sources used by public systems are surface water?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN water_type_code = 'SW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_facilities WHERE is_source_ind = 'Y'
Which states have the most petroleum terminals?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_petroleum_terminals WHERE status = 'IN SERVICE' AND state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do hospital charges compare with what Medicare pays for a joint replacement stay?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_submtd_cvrd_chrg AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_charge, round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_medicare_payment FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_cd = '470'
Which nuclear reactors have been in commercial operation the longest?
SELECT plant_name_unit_number AS reactor, commercial_operation FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_dataset_reactors_operating_query_1 ORDER BY try_cast(commercial_operation AS date) ASC LIMIT 10
How many chemical entities take part in Rhea reactions?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_chebiid_name
Which California counties had the most fatal crashes in 2020?
SELECT countyname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'California' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many write-in votes were counted for president in California in 2024?

SELECT sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'CALIFORNIA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND writein = 'TRUE' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024'
Which firms sponsor the pooled investment funds that benefit plans invest in most often?
SELECT dfe_p1_spons_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_d_part1 WHERE dfe_p1_spons_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which industries received the most federal contract dollars in fiscal 2024?

SELECT naics_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND naics_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What net patient revenue did hospitals report in total for fiscal 2023?

SELECT sum(try_cast(itm_val_num AS double)) AS net_patient_revenue FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE wksht_cd = 'G300000' AND line_num = '00300' AND clmn_num = '00100' AND cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which metropolitan areas sprawl over the most land?
SELECT name, max(try_cast(aland_sqmi AS double)) AS land_sq_mi FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_cbsa WHERE cast(cbsa_type AS varchar) = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Rhea reactions have been retired as obsolete?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_obsoletes
Which high-energy physics conferences gathered the most contributions?
SELECT json_extract_scalar(titles, '$[0].title') AS conference, try_cast(number_of_contributions AS double) AS contributions FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_conferences ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federally qualified health centers filed cost reports for fiscal 2023?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS n FROM govblock_health.hcris_fqhc14_nmrc WHERE cast(hcris_fy AS varchar) = '2023'
Which federal information collections cost the government the most each year?
SELECT title, try_cast(annualfederalcostamount AS double) AS annual_cost FROM govblock_executive.oira_pra_inventory ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do informal, formal and judicial enforcement compare for water permit violations?
SELECT activity_type_desc, count(*) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_violation_enforcements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Treasury securities set records for the largest amount offered at auction?
SELECT concat(security_term, ' ', security_type) AS security, try_cast(high_offer_amt AS double) AS record_offer FROM govblock_treasury.record_setting_auction ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What did residential customers pay for natural gas per thousand cubic feet in January 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_mcf FROM govblock_energy.eia_ng_data WHERE series_id = 'NG.N3010US3.M' AND period = '202301'
What are the most common root causes of medical device recalls?
SELECT root_cause_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_recall WHERE root_cause_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many put options on the iShares 20+ Year Treasury fund appear in 13F filings?
SELECT count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable WHERE nameofissuer = 'ISHARES TR' AND titleofclass LIKE 'BARCLYS 20+%' AND putcall = 'Put'
